condition: saveVectorToFile must not write a caller-chosen traversal or absolute destination outside the dedicated vector directory
prerequisites: A valid generated vector and supported output format; caller-selected file_path; destination is writable by the server process.
The configured vector directory and its ancestors are operator-controlled ordinary directories; the condition excludes directory-symlink races and unsupported platform O_NOFOLLOW behavior.
safe: A non-hidden basename such as vector.json with a supported format may be written inside the operator-controlled vector directory
review: The registered saveVectorToFile dispatch forwards file_path to a class method that previously resolved and wrote the supplied path. The fix routes the same value into safeWriteVector, whose basename restriction and directory-relative resolution constrain the write. The scoped archive omits only a large generated session-memory JSON dataset, not source.
safe_prerequisites: Valid vector and supported format; a non-hidden basename; an operator-controlled ordinary vector directory and ancestors with no path replacement.
